name: code-change-discipline
description: Stop the agent from grepping its way through a large repo. Augments codebase-memory-mcp (>= 0.11.0) with what it does not ship: a discovery ladder with silent-truncation detection, LSP as the tiebreaker, narrow-window editing, verification by test count, a sweeping-change playbook for migrations that outgrow one context, and hooks that enforce all of it -- including auto-approval of read-only graph queries so they do not prompt in plan mode. Hooks run on macOS, Linux and Windows without Git Bash.
